items.question: What is Abzar Kankor?
items.answer: Abzar Kankor is a learning platform that brings school courses, flashcards, mock Kankor exams and a digital library to students, instructors and schools on the web and on Android.

items.question: Does it work without internet?
items.answer: Yes. You can download lessons, flashcards and books and study offline; your progress syncs once you are back online.

items.question: Does it cost anything?
items.answer: A large part of the content is free. Some specialised courses may have a price, which is always shown before you enrol.

items.question: How are certificates issued?
items.answer: When every lesson and exam in a course is complete, a course certificate is issued, and anyone can check it with its unique code on the certificate verification page.

items.question: How can my school join?
items.answer: Create a school account, invite members and instructors with codes, then publish your courses and content. Student progress reports live in the same panel.

items.question: How do I contact the team?
items.answer: Use the contact section on this page or email our support team — we usually reply within 24 hours.

roadmap.title: A clear path to your Kankor goal
roadmap.subtitle: A practical roadmap that turns a big exam goal into small, steady wins. Start where you are and move at your own pace.
steps: Take a short diagnostic quiz and identify the subjects that need the most attention.
Choose a realistic routine, set weekly targets, and balance lessons with revision.
Follow structured courses and ask your teacher or school for guidance when you need it.
Use flashcards and short quizzes to strengthen recall and revisit difficult topics.
Review your results every week, celebrate progress, and focus your next study sessions.
roadmap.note: Your roadmap is flexible. Adjust the pace around your school schedule and keep showing up.
